en: Tap the pencil tool, and you can{SAUT}draw walls on the map.
The eraser tool removes walls.
The brush tool colors in tiles.
The dustcloth tool erases floors.
Tapping the color button and{SAUT}selecting a color will allow{SAUT}you to change the tint.
Place icons such as doors on the{SAUT}map by dragging them.
To delete icons on the map, drag{SAUT}them to the trash can with the{SAUT}pencil tool.
Tap the icon to change the color.
Tap the floor number while{SAUT}the whole map is displayed, and{SAUT}just that floor will display.
Tap the labyrinth button to{SAUT}select the labyrinth and floor.
When you tap the compass on{SAUT}the top left, you can keep the{SAUT}player icon facing up while the{SAUT}map changes direction.
Return it to its default settings by{SAUT}tapping the compass again.
If you make a mistake, tap{SAUT}Undo to cancel the last action.
Use Auto Pilot to move{SAUT}automatically.
Draw the route you would like{SAUT}to go with the route pen in the{SAUT}Auto Pilot menu.
Travel the route you drew and{SAUT}tap the move button to start{SAUT}moving automatically.
By tapping the line that was{SAUT}drawn by the route pen you can{SAUT}go backwards.
Use the route eraser to delete{SAUT}the Auto Pilot line. Erase it from{SAUT}the end of the line.
Drag the icons onto the free{SAUT}palette to save your favorite icons.
Delete unwanted icons from the{SAUT}free palette by dragging them to{SAUT}the trash can.
During special screenings, you{SAUT}will have a special screening{SAUT}palette. It will have icons you{SAUT}can place only during screenings.
However, you cannot place{SAUT}special screening icons on top{SAUT}of others that were placed at a{SAUT}different time.
